name: Leverage Deadlift
instructions: Load the pins to an appropriate weight. Position yourself directly between the handles. Grasp the bottom handles with a comfortable grip, and then lower your hips as you take a breath. Look forward with your head and keep your chest up. This will be your starting position.
Return the weight to the starting position.
longevityNotes: A strong hinge is back insurance. Learn it light, groove it often, and add load slowly — the goal is a back that never complains about picking things up.
overview: Leverage Deadlift is a beginner hip-hinge exercise targeting the quadriceps, performed with a machine. The hinge is the foundation of safe lifting — it teaches you to load the hips, not the spine.
